decisions.statement: The walk is reported in priority order.
The first rule that matches decides the action.
An item rule written against the item decides the action before any ordered rule.
An item the player locked in game is decided by the ordered rules alone.
Naming no character lets the freshest scan win.
An item no scan has refuses the call.
The junk state the scan captured is carried into the account of the item.

definition: the command tracing why an item resolves to the action the rules give it
